lines.beaver: 수아 씨, 회사 창립 기념일 행사 준비 중이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Sua, I'm preparing the company anniversary event.
lines.beaver_roman: Sua ssi, hoesa changnip ginyeomil haengsa junbi jungieyo.
lines.en: Oh, we had an anniversary event last year too.

lines.beaver_en: Right. How was it back then?
lines.en: We held it the day right after a national holiday.

lines.beaver_en: Did a lot of guests come?
lines.learner: 네, 초청장을 백 장 넘게 보냈었어요.
lines.en: Yes, we sent over a hundred invitation cards.
lines.roman: Ne, chocheongjangeul baek jang neomge bonaesseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, that's a lot. Who did you invite?
lines.en: We invited people from our client companies.

lines.beaver_en: Was there an event program too?
lines.learner: 네, 경품 이벤트가 있었는데 인기가 많았어요.
lines.en: Yes, there was a prize event, and it was very popular.
lines.roman: Ne, gyeongpum ibenteuga isseonneunde ingiga manasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did you use to hold other events too?
lines.en: We used to hold a small culture festival every anniversary.
No, it's gone. I'd like us to do it again.

lines.beaver_en: When should we hold it this time?
lines.learner: 작년엔 비가 와서 힘들었었어요. 맑은 날이 좋아요.
lines.en: Last year it rained and was hard. A clear day is best.
lines.roman: Jangnyeonen biga waseo himdeureosseosseoyo. Malgeun nari joayo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 다음 달 첫째 주 금요일 어때요?
lines.beaver_en: Then how about Friday of the first week next month?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom daeum dal cheotjjae ju geumyoil eottaeyo?
lines.en: Sounds good. I'll make the invitation cards.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Preparing got easier thanks to you.
lines.en: You're welcome. This event will go well too.
